newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-REKDAL TO BOOST HERTHA BERLIN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REKDAL TO BOOST HERTHA BERLIN SQUAD.

text.p: Promoted Hertha Berlin have boosted their squad for the German first division next season by signing Norwegian international midfielder Kjetil-Andre Rekdal.
Hertha, who clinched promotion to the Bundesliga last month, said on Wednesday that it had agreed financial terms with French club Rennes for Rekdal to join the club on a three-year contract.
No details of the transfer fee were announced but German media reported that the transfer fee was about one million marks ($579,000).
Rekdal, 28, played in the Bundesliga with Borussia Moenchengladbach between 1988 and 1990. He has won 58 caps for Norway.
Hertha have already signed Hendrik Herzog from VfB Stuttgart, Sergei Mandrenko from Rapid Vienna, Carsten Lakies from Bayern Munich and Dick van Burik from Dutch team Utrecht.
